title: HELIX Bridge: Salesforce → Constituent
architecture_notes: Many institutions run advancement on Salesforce with NPSP or Nonprofit Cloud. Rollup fields are convenient but recompute in gold from HELIX Gift so totals follow CASE rules. Wealth screening and capacity fields are restricted to prospect research.

source_objects.description: The donor, alumnus, parent, or friend.
Lifetime giving, last gift, largest gift, consecutive years.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from institution_id + Contact.Id (or Account.Id for organizations).
Resolve to HELIX Person (same person as the student and alumni records).
Resolve to HELIX Student when the constituent is a current or former student.

attribute_mappings.source: Constituent type or record type; affiliations
attribute_mappings.transformation: Map through helix/constituent-type (alumnus, donor, parent, friend, faculty_staff, corporation, foundation, prospect).

attribute_mappings.source: Relationship manager or portfolio owner field
Account (employer affiliation) or a title and company field

extraction_methods.description: Default. SOQL by SystemModstamp high-water mark; queryAll to include deleted rows. Included with API-enabled editions.
Near real-time change events for objects that need freshness. A limited number of objects is included; more needs an add-on. Check your contract.
AWS-managed Salesforce to S3 flows, scheduled or event-triggered. Priced per flow run and data processed on the AWS side.
Only if the institution already licenses Salesforce Data 360. Not required for HELIX.

validate: Object and field names follow Salesforce's published Agentforce Education (formerly Education Cloud), EDA, NPSP, and standard object models, but orgs add custom fields and record types. VALIDATE every field against your org's describe output before building extracts; custom fields end in __c.
